{"subject":"Claim C019259 past payer filing limit, needs write-off decision","body":"Hi billing lead,

Claim C019259 for patient PT0017 (date of service 2026-10-01, service code T1005, 9 units, billed $43.20) was submitted on 2026-12-28, 88 days after care. Northwind Health Plan's filing limit is 45 days, so the claim is predicted to be denied under D03.

Editing the claim cannot fix this timing issue. I need a write-off decision from you on this claim. Please let me know your decision as soon as possible, ideally before the claim is filed, so we can close it out correctly.

Thank you."}
